integrity: The analytical proof and standalone finite symbolic/numerical checker accompany this record. Finite computations are not an infinite proof. No external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Local three-state bifurcation only; fixed mixing 0<epsilon<1 other than epsilon=2/3. No global attractor classification, rotation-number conclusion, or conclusion at the excluded resonance. The full 2018 Umezuki article remained inaccessible, leaving a historical-priority risk.
title: A universal supercritical circle bifurcation in three-state cyclic softmax feedback
